name: cache-keeper
description: Prompt-cache warm/cold status, tokens and cost, and a nudge to start a fresh chat, with /handoff to carry the conversation over.

cacheTtlSeconds.title: Prompt cache lifetime (seconds)
cacheTtlSeconds.description: 300 for the 5-minute cache, 3600 for the 1-hour cache.

transcriptLine.title: Print status after each reply
transcriptLine.description: Adds a one-line notice to the chat after every reply (the model never reads it, so it costs no tokens). Useful where the app draws no status bar.

nudgeCostUsd.title: Cost nudge (USD)
nudgeCostUsd.description: Suggest a new chat once the session has cost this much.

nudgeContextPercent.title: Context nudge (%)
nudgeContextPercent.description: Suggest a new chat once the context window is this full.

coldGuard.title: Cold-send guard
coldGuard.description: After the cache has expired, hold the first message once and show how much context it would re-read uncached. Send again to go ahead.

coldGuardMinPercent.title: Guard minimum context (%)
coldGuardMinPercent.description: The guard stays out of the way until the context is at least this full.

inChatLine.title: Status above the newest reply
inChatLine.description: Draw the status line in the chat above the latest reply. Needs an app that attaches a display surface; untested, so off by default.
